dedupe_keys.name: china and eu electric passenger vehicle market characteristics 2023

description: The electric-vehicle market research team publishes 2023 passenger-vehicle characteristics for China and the European Union. The Figshare deposit includes country and regional Excel workbooks, variant and battery-density tables, and MATLAB scripts for a bottom-up data-fusion example and clustering. Its own description names market penetration, vehicle segment mix, sales-weighted battery capacity and battery chemistry. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0. These values can inform fleet composition and charging-load assumptions in transport-energy simulations, including work using model-pypsa-eur after geographic adaptation. A caveat is that sales-weighted characteristics describe marketed vehicles, not actual driving, charging availability or battery degradation. Vehicle categories and source-market coverage need checking before merging the China and EU tables. The repository metadata and file manifest were inspected without opening the workbooks or running MATLAB. The companion scripts are included in this same deposit, not drafted as a separate resource.
